tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: The window's ground.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: A card, a panel, a field: what sits on the canvas.

tokens.name: color-sunken
tokens.usage: A well in a surface: a search field, a track.

tokens.name: color-raised
tokens.usage: A dialog, a menu: what floats above.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: A secondary control under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-pressed
tokens.usage: A secondary control pressed.

tokens.name: color-tint
tokens.usage: The accent's ground: a chosen card, an information banner.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: A line that divides, and only that.

tokens.name: color-edge
tokens.usage: A control's edge, 3:1 on each ground.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: The words.

tokens.name: color-text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary words: a hint, a date, a detail.

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary words, on any ground at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus, the primary action; « Vous ».

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: The primary action under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Words on the accent.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Ready, sent, saved: success alone, never a voice.

tokens.name: color-success-ground
tokens.usage: A success chip's ground, opaque: its words keep 4.5:1 on any page.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: A warning's icon and words.

tokens.name: color-warning-ground
tokens.usage: A warning's ground.

tokens.name: color-record
tokens.usage: A recording: its live dot. Red says a recording or a deletion, nothing else.

tokens.name: color-destructive
tokens.usage: A deletion's button, always confirmed, « Annuler » focused.

tokens.name: color-on-destructive
tokens.usage: Words on a deletion's button.

tokens.name: color-private
tokens.usage: « Confidentielle », with the lock: its pill, its banner. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: color-private-ground
tokens.usage: The ground of « Confidentielle »'s banner.

tokens.name: color-voice-you
tokens.usage: « Vous »: the microphone, in the waveform, the meters, the transcript.

tokens.name: color-voice-others
tokens.usage: « Les autres »: the call's sound; teal in light, golden amber in dark.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: e1
tokens.usage: An elevation: e1 a card, e2 a toast, e3 a dialog.
